answer: Producing a novel, coherent answer each epoch is cheap per alias but prohibitive across thousands, so scale buys less credibility — the attacker cannot simply buy a large, credible flock. Consequently, an attacker with a large flock pays more to keep it alive than it can ever extract, which is why Sybil campaigns fail here.. The mechanism is sound because grades are sealed and only opened at close, which stops a cluster from coordinating its votes inside a single jury. Consider a inlet as the anchor of the cost.
